job_location: Seattle, Washington, United States of America
responsibilities: Design, develop, and support complex data pipelines from a wide variety of data sources for Redfin
Work with other Engineering teams to design and implement data exchange systems from structured and unstructured data sources
Work with end users to gather requirements and design solutions that provide the the data they need in the format they need it in
Ensure 100% accuracy in everything you do - make sure that all code and processes are fully tested and verified before running in production
Identify and implement internal process improvements by automating manual processes and optimizing for accuracy, performance and coding best practices
Support and maintain dev / test / prod environments
Serve as part of weekly on call rotation

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Ensure 100% accuracy in everything you do - make sure that all code and processes are fully tested and verified before running in production
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: An explicit "100% accuracy" mandate with full testing before production outweighs the single "fast paced, constantly changing environment" in the requirements.
evidence.domain_risk: Redfin is revolutionizing the $75 billion real estate industry.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: A consumer real estate platform at scale, but the posting names no financial reporting, audit or regulatory consequence for the data work.
evidence.data_team_maturity: As a Data Engineer II, you will share ownership of Redfin's Data Platform, owning business critical data integrations and operational excellence.
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: An established Data Platform with separate Engineering and Analytics teams, dev/test/prod environments and an on-call rotation.
evidence.jd_authorship: Ensure 100% accuracy in everything you do - make sure that all code and processes are fully tested and verified before running in production
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: The bullets carry a real standard and a real duty — the accuracy mandate and the weekly on-call rotation — rather than generic stakeholder language.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: You will work closely with Engineering and Analytics teams to create and support data pipelines and transformations.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The named partners are Engineering and Analytics teams consuming the shared Data Platform.
evidence.autonomy_level: Work with end users to gather requirements and design solutions that provide the the data they need in the format they need it in
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Work arrives as gathered requirements, and the role shares rather than owns the platform.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: AI is not mentioned anywhere in the posting.
evidence.testing_framing: make sure that all code and processes are fully tested and verified before running in production
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Full testing and verification before production is stated as the candidate's own accountability, not a tool in a skills list.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Ensure 100% accuracy in everything you do
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: A 100% accuracy demand in the fourth responsibility, plus an on-call rotation, makes getting it wrong the dominant concern.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: The ideal candidate is a data pipeline builder who enjoys optimizing existing systems as well as building new systems from the ground up.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The posting says outright that the work is both optimising existing systems and building new ones.
evidence.loss_aversion: "Ensure 100% accuracy in everything you do - make sure that all code and processes are fully tested and verified before running in production" — an absolute accuracy standard written into the responsibilities.
